dog.description_text: My foster writes: My name is Sir Scooby and that is because I am a consummate gentleman. I am attentive, as gentle as you need and am a lap dog in a big dog body. I am great with children 10 and up and have introduced myself, calmly and with grace, one by one to families as large as five (three teens and two adults). I am so intelligent that I learned how to great my foster mom's 78 year old mother on face time! I am fully house broken. I am all man, loyal and protective but when my foster mom says that we are safe, I know I can immediately rest because we rely on trusting each other. My foster mom says I am a catch and that if she did not work 12 hour days at a health clinic, she would adopt me immediately because I am a one in a million, gentleman!
dog.name: Sir Scooby
